resources.string: Keeps in touch with your loco server.
An administrator is viewing and controlling this device\'s screen.

Lets loco show and control the device when you open the remote screen from the portal: see the screen without asking to share it each time, tap, scroll, go back, and type text into the focused field — including, when the device is locked, the code you type from the portal. A sleeping screen is turned on when a session opens. Nothing is read or sent outside a session you opened from the portal, and the device then shows \u00ab Remote control in progress \u00bb.
The device will be removed from this server and the agent will stop. You can enroll it again later.
Enter the server address and the enrollment key shown by the portal, in My fleet › Enrollment, Android tab.
Enter an https address and a key.
Server unreachable. Check the address and the network.
Compare this fingerprint with the one shown by the loco portal. Confirm only if it matches.

loco shows this screen during a session opened from the portal, and the device says so. Once remote control is turned on below, there is nothing left to do here; this button only gives a smoother picture.
Lets you see the screen at every session without coming back to this app, and tap, scroll, go back and type from the portal.
If Android answers \u00ab access denied \u00bb: open Settings › Apps › loco Agent, the ⋮ menu at the top right, \u00ab Allow restricted settings \u00bb, then come back here.
Lets the portal browse, download and upload your files.
An item already has this name.
An item already has this name at the destination.
Copied, but the original could not be deleted.
File access not allowed on the device: in the loco app, tap \u00ab Allow access to files \u00bb.
Not enough space on the device.
Remote screen not allowed on the device: in the loco app, turn on remote control once (accessibility), or tap \u00ab Turn on the remote screen \u00bb.
Session type not supported on Android.
Allow loco to keep running in the background: otherwise the device may put it to sleep and the connection is lost when the screen is off.
Lets loco install the apps you deploy from the portal. Android asks you to confirm each new app.
Confirmations for installs requested from loco.
Requested from loco: tap to confirm the install.
Requested from loco: tap “Install” in the Play Store.
%1$s: Google Play page opened on the device, install it from the Play Store.
%1$s: page opened in the device\'s store (no Google Play).
%1$s: no store on the device, Google Play page opened in the browser.
the APK does not match the requested app
signing key differs from the one announced by the repository
already installed with another signature (%1$s): uninstall it first
install not confirmed on the device
Action not supported by the Android app.
Device removed from loco; the app stays installed.
loco must be allowed to install apps to install %1$s: turn on “Allow from this source”.
permission to install not granted on the device
%1$s is waiting for your confirmation in Android\'s install window.
The device is enrolling on loco with the settings bundled in the app. One moment…
The authority fingerprint does not match the one expected by the app: automatic enrollment cancelled. Check the address, then try again manually.
Choose where this device stays in touch with loco. Elsewhere the agent is paused: no contact, no session, nothing is sent.
Wi-Fi, wired network and mobile data.
On any Wi-Fi or wired network, never on the mobile network.
Only on the Wi-Fi networks you name.
Android only gives the name of a Wi-Fi network to apps allowed to use location. loco never reads your position: the permission only serves to recognise the Wi-Fi. Without it, the agent stays paused.
To recognise the Wi-Fi when the app is not on screen, Android asks for “Allow all the time”. Without it, the agent pauses as soon as you leave this screen.
Location is turned off on this device: Android then hides the Wi-Fi name, and the agent stays paused.
No approved Wi-Fi: the agent stays paused everywhere.
Version %1$s is available (this device has %2$s). It also installs by itself; this button installs it now.
First allow loco to install apps.
Download failed: check that the device reaches loco, then try again.
The file received is not the expected update: nothing was installed.
This device is paired with loco: every session shows the screen with a smooth picture, with nothing to touch here.

Without it, Android limits the picture to about 3 per second. Do it once, in two minutes: tap Set up, turn on “Wireless debugging”, then “Pair device with pairing code”. Keep that window open, pull down the notification shade and type the six-digit code in the loco notification.
Without it, Android limits the picture to about 3 per second. First turn on developer options: in “About phone”, tap “Build number” seven times, then come back here.
In “Wireless debugging”, tap “Pair device with pairing code”, then type the six-digit code here without closing that window.
Paired: the picture will be smooth from the next session. Keep wireless debugging on.
Pairing window not found: open “Pair device with pairing code” again, then type the new code.
loco is unreachable: check that the device is on the same network as loco.
